bottlenecks_identified.name: DataLoader single-threaded
bottlenecks_identified.description: num_workers=0 serialises dataset loading to the main process, starving the GPU between batches.

bottlenecks_identified.name: CPU-GPU sync on every step
bottlenecks_identified.description: loss.item() called every training step forces the CPU to wait for the GPU kernel to complete, breaking pipelining.
bottlenecks_identified.fix: Move .item() inside the log block (every log_interval steps only)

bottlenecks_identified.name: Mixed precision disabled
bottlenecks_identified.description: mixed_precision=False (default) causes all matmuls to run in FP32; FP16 AMP reduces memory bandwidth pressure by 2x.

bottlenecks_identified.name: No fault tolerance
bottlenecks_identified.description: No autosave; an 8-day run crashed with zero recoverable state.
bottlenecks_identified.fix: 30-min autosave daemon thread + atomic write + wall-clock segmentation

notes: Profile conducted on Session Speed overhaul. Exact GPU utilisation percentages are estimates based on observed step times before/after fixes.
